missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the profile button element to be visible and clickable, then perform a click action. This method should specifically target the profile button in the devicesMFE context, distinct from existing avatar/icon click methods. Should handle any loading states and verify the profile panel or menu opens successfully.

resolved_intents.intent: Get tell your experience text value

missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the edit feedback screen is displayed after clicking the feedback button. Should check for the presence of key elements such as the feedback slide title, the 'tell your experience' text field, dropdown menus for feedback categories, and the submit button. Should return True if all required elements are visible, False otherwise. Should include appropriate timeout handling and raise exceptions if the screen fails to load within the expected timeframe.

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the text entered in the 'tell your experience' field is truncated to the maximum allowed character limit. Should retrieve the current text value from the feedback text field, compare its length against the expected maximum length (default 1000 characters), and assert that the text does not exceed this limit. Should also verify that the character count display shows the correct truncated length. Should raise an AssertionError with a descriptive message if the text is not properly truncated or if the character count is incorrect.
